criteria.criterion: Grain, cohort and denominator are explicitly defined
Department summary reconciles and preserves encounter grain
Therapeutic class ranking and interpretation are correct
Data-quality checks are reproducible and correctly scoped
SQL is readable, parameter-safe where applicable and reproducible

critical_errors: Encounter counts inflated by order-level joins without DISTINCT or pre-aggregation
Order count described as medication administration or adherence
Synthetic readmission flag described as validated clinical outcome
PHI or credentials committed to portfolio repository
